successful_release_build.compiler_workaround: Candle-only single codegen unit avoids LLVM23 VPDerivedIVRecipe trap; O3/native/vectorization retained

reproduced_failure: SIGTRAP in LLVM VPDerivedIVRecipe::execute during Candle code generation/local ThinLTO.
workaround: Set profile.release.package.candle-core.codegen-units=1 on the Cargo command line; keep opt-level3, target-cpu=native and vectorization. No dependency source patch or workspace profile edit.
